title: VSN 剧情场景脚本（结局与平行版本）（第 2／5 部分）

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hey, you don't have to hurt him anymore! See, I've got him. He's being good!
rows.current: text: 喂，不用再打他了！看，我控制住他了。他很乖！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I've actually been studying this species in depth. I'm basically an expert now!
rows.current: text: 我可是深入研究过这个物种的，基本算专家啦！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They might look a lil scary, but they're really just misunderstood, ya know?
rows.current: text: 他们看着有点吓人，其实只是被误解了，懂吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And to think that I ran away  the first time I met a pack of barkers!
rows.current: text: 想想当初，第一次遇到一群吠犬，我竟然掉头就跑！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Admittedly, they kinda ambushed and scattered my squad!
rows.current: text: 得承认，他们确实伏击并冲散了我的小队！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: To a layperson, that might seem a little hostile. Now I know that we should have all
rows.current: text: 外行或许觉得这有点敌意。现在我才懂，我们都该直接抬起尾巴，任他们操进来配种！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: just lifted our tails and let them breed us straight away!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Naturally, I had no hope of outrunning these swift and powerful hunters!
rows.current: text: 当然，我根本跑不过这些敏捷强壮的猎手！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: After a brief chase, they knocked me to the ground for even daring to try.
rows.current: text: 追了没多久，他们就把我扑倒，惩罚我竟敢逃跑。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As they tore the suit from my body, I was too weak to fight them...
rows.current: text: 他们撕扯我身上的制服时，我虚弱得无力反抗……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It was pretty scary! I thought they were gonna eat me right there!
rows.current: text: 真吓人！我以为他们当场就要吃了我！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But I quickly realized that they were more curious than hungry...
rows.current: text: 但我很快就发现，他们与其说是饿，不如说是好奇……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and one particular place was getting an awful lot of attention!
rows.current: text: ……尤其是某个部位，格外受他们关注！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So - nervously at first! - I spread out to let them get a closer look.
rows.current: text: 于是——起初还挺紧张！——我张开双腿，让他们看个仔细。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As an eager but gentle tongue lapped at my sex, I was confronted
rows.current: text: 热切又温柔的舌头舔着我的小穴时，眼前却凑来吠犬身上一个熟悉得出奇的部位……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: with a surprisingly familiar part of barker anatomy...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My heart was racing, but training kicked in and I began to nurse that shaft.
rows.current: text: 我心跳如鼓，可训练的本能发作，便开始吮吸那根肉棒。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: When I closed my eyes, it was kinda like a little taste of home, hehe...
rows.current: text: 一闭上眼，还真有点家的味道，嘿嘿……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I must have done a pretty good job too, because soon enough the rest of the
rows.current: text: 我一定伺候得很不错，因为没多久，群里的其他同伴都排起队等我的嘴。我上外星语言学课也许在睡觉，可只需一点‘外星舔语’，就能跟这些男生沟通啦！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: pack was lining up for my mouth. I may have slept through exolinguistics class

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but a little 'exolingus' is all I needed to communicate with these boys!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: After that first encounter, I happily joined their pack. For a while, I even tried
rows.current: text: 初次交欢后，我开开心心地入了群。有阵子，我甚至试着四脚着地，到处爬，汪汪叫、低声吼。他们还挺喜欢！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: walking around on all fours, barking and growling. They seemed to like that!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But most of all, they liked it when I raised my tail for them...
rows.current: text: 不过，他们最喜欢的还是我翘起尾巴……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh yes, I did some  v e r y  thorough field work. All the data you could want!
rows.current: text: 没错，我的实地调查可真够深入。要什么数据都有！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: My packmates were demanding lovers, but never took me harder than I could handle.
rows.current: text: 族里的伴侣虽索求无度，却从不会操得让我受不了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Sucking 'em may have reminded me a lil of home...
rows.current: text: 给他们口交时，倒让我有点想起家里……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but there was nothing homestyle about how they mounted me!
rows.current: text: ……可他们骑上来操我的方式，跟家里完全不同！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Good luck finding a two leg- ged guy who makes you gasp with every! single! thrust!
rows.current: text: 想找个两条腿的家伙，每！一！下！都能顶得你倒抽气？做梦吧！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Eventually, one of the bigger males decided that I was proper mate material.
rows.current: text: 终于，有个大块头雄性觉得我很适合当配偶。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not much of a talker, but he knew how to treat a girl, if ya know what I mean!
rows.current: text: 他话不多，却懂得怎么疼姑娘，你懂的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: He protected me, hunted for me, and mounted me  h a r d  every night!
rows.current: text: 他保护我、为我狩猎，每晚都狠狠地干我！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: He was the first to actually tie me, and jeez that... that was...huff...
rows.current: text: 他是第一个真跟我锁结的，天哪，那……那简直……呼……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A! M! A! Z! I! N! G!
rows.current: text: 爽！翻！天！了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was walking funny for like two days, but I didn't care!
rows.current: text: 我走路别扭了两天，可我才不在乎！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: He took me away and we kinda settled down together in this little den.
rows.current: text: 他把我带走，我们就在这小窝里一起安顿下来了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I think he was tryin' to gimme his puppies. It was pretty cute <3
rows.current: text: 我看，他是想让我怀上他的小狗崽。挺可爱的 <3

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: So the next time you see a barker, don't go smacking him around!
rows.current: text: 所以下次见到吠犬，可别上去就揍他！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Holster that tazer and back away slowly. Or just lift your tail, hehe...
rows.current: text: 收起电击枪，慢慢后退。或者干脆翘起尾巴，嘿嘿……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's about time someone showed up! What took you so long?
rows.current: text: 可算来人了！你怎么拖了这么久？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Leaving a girl like me cooped up like this... what's the big idea?
rows.current: text: 竟把我这样的姑娘关在这儿……到底什么意思？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Let's get the debriefing over with so I can hunt down the jerks that left me here.
rows.current: text: 赶紧汇报完吧，我还得去找那些把我丢在这儿的混蛋算账。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: There was a whole group of Kobos. Spotted them while I was scouting out the area
rows.current: text: 我侦察那一带时，发现了一整群科博德。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Seemed like they had no discipline, just sitting around gaggling and giggling
rows.current: text: 他们毫无纪律，就坐在那儿叽叽喳喳、嬉笑打闹，连可能路过的贪婪特工都不提防！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: not even keeping a lookout for any sort of rapacious agents that might come by!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Made my vulpine blood boil to see such lackaisical pirates...
rows.current: text: 海盗这么懒散，看得我这狐狸都火冒三丈……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...so down I want, tazer first, to show these slobs how things should go!
rows.current: text: ……我举着电击枪下去，教这群蠢货该怎么办！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Didn't take much to make the cowards submit. As soon as I took out the first one
rows.current: text: 让这帮胆小鬼屈服很容易。我刚放倒头一个，剩下的海盗就全举手投降了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the remaining pirates just threw their hands up in the air.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...It was even worse than I thought!
rows.current: text: ……简直比我想的还糟！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I tried to offer myself up as their plaything once or twice
rows.current: text: 我试着主动献身，当他们的玩物，一两次吧，可他们怕我的电击枪，最后还得逼他们交配。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but they were so cowed by my tazer that I ended up having to force them to rut.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Have you ever even /thought/ of something so pathetic?
rows.current: text: 你真有/想过/会有这么窝囊的事吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Space pirates that weren't even willing to sex up a willing fox...
rows.current: text: 堂堂太空海盗，连送上门的狐狸都不肯干……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A few nights into trying to encourage these lizard brats to be more proactive
rows.current: text: 我花了好几个晚上，想让这些蜥蜴崽子主动点，结果，我基本只能放弃这个念头。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and I basically had to give up on that idea.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The most they were willing to do was steady themselves on my thighs
rows.current: text: 他们最多也就肯扶着我的大腿稳住身子，一边给我舔穴。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: while they ate me out.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A last ditch effort where I literally collared and leashed myself around them
rows.current: text: 最后我孤注一掷，真给自己套上项圈和牵绳，在他们身边转，盼着谁能把我一把拽倒，任意玩弄我，结果全都白费了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: hoping one of them would yank me down and have their way with me

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: turned out to be in vain...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Instead they just gingerly carried it around as if I were a queen or something!
rows.current: text: 他们反而小心翼翼地抬着它到处走，像把我当女王一样！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hmm, Vickers... Queen of the space pirates...
rows.current: text: 嗯，维克斯……太空海盗女王……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That's a thought that I started to entertain, I'll admit!
rows.current: text: 我承认，自己还真开始动这念头了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: If it weren't for stumbling into a fellow agent down one of these dark halls...
rows.current: text: 要不是在某条漆黑走廊里碰巧遇见另一位特工……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was about to give my salutations and show them the tricks my pets could do
rows.current: text: 我正想打个招呼，让他们看看我宠物的拿手好戏，可咱这位特工二话不说，就亮起了电击枪！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but this agent of ours just flashed their tazer on without saying a word!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's almost like they weren't even listening, not to me nor the pirates...
rows.current: text: 那位同事简直谁的话都不听，不听我的，也不听海盗的……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: the pirates that screamed and turned tail, even without me giving an order!
rows.current: text: 那些海盗尖叫着掉头就跑，都不用我下令！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was about to be impressed with them having minds of their own, but...
rows.current: text: 我正想夸他们终于有点主见了，可是……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I was too busy getting my tail kicked!
rows.current: text: ……我光顾着挨揍了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Couldn't get a good look at whoever this silent agent was, but they were good.
rows.current: text: 没看清那位一声不吭的特工是谁，不过身手真不错。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And maybe I'd grown a little sloppy, me and my fantasies of being a pirate queen.
rows.current: text: 也许我光顾着做海盗女王的美梦，有点松懈了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Even so, after they knocked me out the mute usurper didn't stick around
rows.current: text: 不过，他们打昏我后，那个哑巴篡位者并没留下。我被随手扔在地上，任我慢慢恢复。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was left unceremoniously on the ground, to recover at my leisure.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...or so I thought...
rows.current: text: ……至少我当时这么想……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Those damn kobo curs took that opportunity to finally show some initiative!
rows.current: text: 那些该死的科博杂种，偏在这时主动起来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: With my energy sapped, they took to using me as their breeding toy
rows.current: text: 我没了力气，他们就把我当成配种玩具来用，这本来就是我盼着他们干的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: like I originally wanted them to!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Still, it seemed like a bit of a disappointment since I couldn't enjoy it 100%
rows.current: text: 不过，没法尽情享受，还是有点失望

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They'd finally dumped me into this cell where I've recovered, and I was hoping
rows.current: text: 最后他们把我扔进这牢房，我缓过来了，还盼着他们能再来把我狠狠干个够。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that they'd come and try use me up again.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Instead, it's just a very late rescue. What a joke!
rows.current: text: 结果只是姗姗来迟的救援。真是笑话！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well there you have it, debrief over. And if you'll excuse me...
rows.current: text: 好了，汇报完毕。没别的事，我就……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I'll be on my way to find out where those lizard dogs are...
rows.current: text: ……我得去找找那群蜥蜴狗在哪儿……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Golly! Thanks for saving me! Hasn't this all been pretty amazing?
rows.current: text: 哇！谢谢你救我！这一切是不是超刺激？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No wonder they made all us rookies sign liability waivers before the mission!
rows.current: text: 难怪出任务前，要我们这些新人全签免责书！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'd barely gotten used to wearing a spacesuit before I found myself in this mess.
rows.current: text: 我连宇航服都刚穿惯，就摊上这烂摊子。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Shortly after landing on this planet far far away from my cozy desk chair...
rows.current: text: 才刚降落到这颗星球，离我舒服的办公椅远得不能再远……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I summarily found myself lost and alone, without even my mission files to read.
rows.current: text: 转眼我就独自迷路了，连任务档案都没得看。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It didn't take long before some sort of...of...VILLAIN cornered and disarmed me!
rows.current: text: 没多久，一个……一个……恶棍就把我堵住，还缴了械！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh but that wasn't even the most shocking part, let me tell you...!
rows.current: text: 可跟你说，这还不是最震惊的部分……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I didn't even have time to put up a fight while this beast of a man had his way.
rows.current: text: 这禽兽般的男人肆意蹂躏我，我连反抗都来不及。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Him and his gang did what they pleased, all I could do was give in to them.
rows.current: text: 他和那帮同伙为所欲为，我只能任他们摆布。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I wish I could tell you more about them but I had my eyes shut the entire time!
rows.current: text: 我也想多说些他们的事，可我全程都闭着眼！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Over and over I was taken; my ability to resist was sapped away all the while.
rows.current: text: 我被一遍遍地干，反抗的力气也不断流失。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'd never known these kind of sensations outside of training at the academy
rows.current: text: 除了学院训练，我从没体验过这种感觉。被强加的快感一波波袭来，我几乎承受不住。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it all seemed like too much as I rode out the waves of pleasure forced upon me.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Eventually I roused with a start to find the gang gone.
rows.current: text: 后来我猛地惊醒，才发现那帮家伙都走了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Disoriented and unable to see, I crawled around looking for my glasses.
rows.current: text: 我晕头转向，什么也看不清，只能到处爬着找眼镜。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But alas, it seemed like another cruel villain found me first!
rows.current: text: 可惜啊，倒是另一个凶恶的坏蛋先找到了我！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This beast with his hungry eyes and large, strong paws, knew what he wanted.
rows.current: text: 这野兽目光饥渴，爪子硕大有力，清楚自己想要什么。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Even now as I think of the way that prowl of monsters treated me...
rows.current: text: 直到现在，想起那群怪物怎样对我……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...I...get a shiver down my...and inside my...
rows.current: text: ……我……就会顺着我的……还有我里面……一阵发颤……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...but the important thing is that I had enough energy and sense this time
rows.current: text: ……重点是，这次我还有足够的精力和理智，留心每一根爽人的倒刺……刮过的……啊……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: to stay alert to the way each raking barb of pleasure...went...ahh...!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It'll be impossible to forget these last few days.
rows.current: text: 这几天的经历，想忘也忘不了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Nothing in my training prepared me for this type of unbridled passion.
rows.current: text: 训练中学的一切，都不足以应付这种放纵的激情。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Day and night I was bred by these fierce creatures as though they were set
rows.current: text: 这些凶猛的家伙日夜给我配种，仿佛铁了心让我生下他们的下一窝。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: on having me bear their next litter.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and I can't wait to see what my next mission will be!
rows.current: text: ……我已经等不及想知道下一次任务了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As us Fenfen strove to rebuild our home and drive out the remnants of evil
rows.current: lang(Fox): 当我们Fenfen奋力重建家园、驱逐邪恶残部时，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: some of us looked up into the sky and saw a shooting star coming down.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中有些人仰望天空，看见一颗流星正坠落而下。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Perhaps Fate had sent us a hero, with which we could regain our peace?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 也许是命运给我们派来了一位英雄，好让我们重获和平？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Or perhaps Fate had a more sinister joke to play on us suffering Fenfen
rows.current: lang(Fox): 又或许，命运对受苦的我们Fenfen还有更阴险的玩笑要开，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: for this visitor from the stars did not land on our planet proper...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 因为这位来自群星的访客，并没有降落在星球本体上……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...instead, they landed on the satellite rock that held Traeh's prison!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而是落在了关押Traeh的囚牢所在的那座卫星岩上！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: As if destined for only a single purpose, the interstellar interloper
rows.current: lang(Fox): 仿佛注定只有一个目的，那位星际闯入者

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: made their way to the very core of Traeh's prison.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一路来到了关押Traeh的囚牢核心。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Had her psychic tendrils found their way into a poor fool's mind?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她的灵能触须，是否已经探入了某个可怜虫的脑中？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: There is no way to know if it was dark ESPer power at work or merely curiosity
rows.current: lang(Fox): 无从得知，究竟是黑暗的超能力者力量在作祟，还是仅仅出于好奇，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but this traveler made contact with the crystal prison that held Traeh...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 但这位旅者确实触碰到了关押Traeh的水晶囚牢……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and so they became undone, unable to resist the dark ESPer forces.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……就这样，这名旅者崩溃了，无力抵挡那股黑暗的超能力量。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Power and pain coursed through the poor explorer
rows.current: lang(Fox): 力量与痛苦席卷这名可怜的探索者全身，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: until their mind was no longer their own.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到连心智也不再由自己掌控。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No, from that moment forth they answered to a darker power...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 不，从那一刻起，这名旅者便听命于一股更黑暗的力量……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: They did as Traeh commanded!
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh吩咐什么，这名旅者就做什么！

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 噢，勇敢的英雄，谢谢你救了我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放到我的手上。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 让心神向内，去见证塑造这片土地的那些往事……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 触碰到Traeh的囚牢之后，那名闯入者便不再是从前的自己。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这名心智被扭曲的特工，将理事会余下的成员逐一抓走，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以此确保囚禁Traeh的力量一天天地衰弱下去。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 即便理事会的智者们仍决心以心灵之力囚禁Traeh，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可在被迫接连遭受一场又一场黑暗实验之后……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……就连Fenfen中最睿智的人，也无法同时应付这么多方面的压力。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
rows.current: lang(Fox): 一旦没有了Fenfen理事会的力量来囚禁Traeh，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她破囚而出、再度开战，便只是时间问题。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而到了那时，将再没有任何力量能够抵挡她的邪恶之力。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
rows.current: lang(Fox): 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 是她想要积蓄足够的力量，转移到一个新的宿主躯体之中。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那么，也许又是命运的一次转折，把你送到了这颗星球，

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你会成为黑暗女王Traeh更加强大的宿主吗？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救主，一座勇气与希望的灯塔……？

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: Fox
rows.source: ...Only you can decide, hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……只有你能决定，英雄。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well now, see what happens when you run away?
rows.current: text: 瞧吧，现在知道逃跑的下场了？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Didn't mean to bonk you so hard, but were you trying to ruin my reputation
rows.current: text: 不是故意敲那么重，可我还没好好采集你的数据，你就想跑，是想砸我的招牌吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: by running away before I could get some proper data on ya?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I tell ya, I used to spend soooo many hours practicing after class.
rows.current: text: 跟你说，我以前课后练习一练就是好——几个钟头。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Signing out larger and larger training tools from the academy
rows.current: text: 从学院领用的训练道具也越来越大，大到连几位教授都怀疑，我是不是练得太急了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: to the point where even some of my professors wondered if I was rushing too much!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: In the end, it was all worth it though.
rows.current: text: 不过到头来，一切都值了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: When I graduated at only 22 years old, with honors, it was big news!
rows.current: text: 才22岁就以优异成绩毕业，我当时可上了大新闻！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was the face of the PPPC's recruitment campaign and everything.
rows.current: text: 我还当过PPPC招募宣传的代言人呢。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Being the youngest agent to ever see active duty was craaaaazy intense.
rows.current: text: 作为史上最年轻的实战特工，压力简直大到爆。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...even if my little brother managed to take that record from me...
rows.current: text: ……虽然最年轻的纪录后来被我弟弟抢走了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But no matter! That doesn't diminish my accomplishments one bit.
rows.current: text: 不过无所谓！这丝毫不损我的功绩。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And no feisty lizard is gonna diminish my reputation one bit, either!
rows.current: text: 再凶的蜥蜴，也别想让我的名声受半点损伤！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...Come here boy!
rows.current: text: ……过来吧，小子！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Let's get this show on the road!
rows.current: text: 好戏开场啦！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not sure what it is about you big ol' overgrown lizards
rows.current: text: 真不懂你们这些长得过头的大蜥蜴是什么体质，可不管打得多凶，你们都不会软，对吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but no amount of fighting ever makes you get soft, does it?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I swear! Sometimes it just seems to be like foreplay to you space pirate types!
rows.current: text: 真受不了！对你们太空海盗来说，打架就像前戏！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Mmmmmf!
rows.current: text: 嗯——唔！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: At least while you're dazed I can warm myself how I like to...
rows.current: text: 至少趁你还晕乎乎的，我能按自己喜欢的方式暖和暖和……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just gotta enjoy your tapered little tip for a bit before the REAL show starts.
rows.current: text: 正式开场前，先享受一下你尖尖的小龟头。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Don't get me wrong, I could handle any of you wannabe badboys with noooo problem.
rows.current: text: 别误会，你们这些装坏小子的家伙，我收拾谁都轻——松。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: But a girl's gotta have some nice and easy days too, you know?
rows.current: text: 可姑娘也得过几天轻松日子，你懂吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: We can't be all romp and pomp ALL the time!
rows.current: text: 总不能一天到晚都闹腾着大干一场嘛！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ahh there ya are, sleepy head! Finally managed to rouse the rest of you, huh?
rows.current: text: 啊，醒啦，小懒虫！这下连你整个人也总算醒过来了，是吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Don't you worry, I'll keep this lighttazer nice and saaafely turned off
rows.current: text: 别担心，只要你别跑，我会让这把光电击枪安安——全全地关着。说定了？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: so long as you don't run. Deal?

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That's what I thought, mmmh hmm!
rows.current: text: 我就知道，嗯哼！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You just... sit back and... mmmh... relax...
rows.current: text: 你只要……靠着……嗯……放松……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: While I show you what a... ahh! Cosmobreeder is all about!
rows.current: text: 让我来教你……啊！宇宙育种者是干什么的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Don't think I'll ever tire of the.... nnngh... nubs you have...
rows.current: text: 你那些……嗯啊……小肉突，我怕是永远也玩不腻……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You darn space pirate lizards get all over the galaxy, but at the same time
rows.current: text: 你们这些该死的蜥蜴太空海盗，整个银河都钻得遍，你们那该死的鸡巴，也特别会往我里面钻……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: your gosh darn dicks are so good at getting all inside me, too...!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I have half a mind to complain about having to study you guys over and over
rows.current: text: 老得反复研究你们，我都想抱怨了，不过看在你们鸡巴上那些爽人凸粒的份上，就算啦，嘿嘿……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but with those pleasurenubs built onto your dicks, I'll let it slide, hehe...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: S...slide... just like that...
rows.current: text: 滑……滑进去……就这样……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……啊！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's been a while since I've had one of you kobofolks grabbing onto my hips
rows.current: text: 我有阵子没被你们科博德搂住胯了，但既然你坚持让我这次掌握主动……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but if you insist on letting me take control this time...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...then we're gonna have to ramp things up!
rows.current: text: ……那咱们可得加把劲了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Warm up time is over, ya know!
rows.current: text: 热身时间结束啦！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Hey! Did you even hear me?
rows.current: text: 喂！你到底听见没有？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Heh, guess this cosmotalent I have has left you just completely speechless.
rows.current: text: 嘿，看来我这宇宙级的本事，真让你一句话都说不出了。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Dooooon't you worry though, I know exactly what I'm doing here.
rows.current: text: 别——担心，我很清楚自己在做什么。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You're in good hands!
rows.current: text: 交给我这双巧手就放心吧！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and mouth!
rows.current: text: ……还有我的嘴！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and... you get the idea!
rows.current: text: ……还有……你明白的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Huff... pant...
rows.current: text: 呼……哈……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Usually I like it when a man grabs me by the hips and helps out
rows.current: text: 平时我挺喜欢男人抓着我的胯，帮我一把，不过我……呼……要让你见识特工独自上阵的本事。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: but I'll... hff... let you see what an agent can do on their own.

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Just this once, mind you!
rows.current: text: 记住，就这一次！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Back in my academy days, I'd be riding up and down on training material
rows.current: text: 当年在学院，我可是天天骑着比你粗一倍的训练器材上下起伏！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that was twice as thick as you. Day after day!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Boys do feel better... nmmm... after a bit of a break, though...
rows.current: text: 不过，歇一阵再跟男人做……嗯……确实更舒服……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh, yeah, there we go...
rows.current: text: 哦，对，就是这样……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I just gotta keep... ahh! Bumping that s-spot until...
rows.current: text: 我只要继续……啊！顶着那、那里，直到……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: U-until...
rows.current: text: 直、直到……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……！！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A h h h h...!
rows.current: text:  啊 啊 啊 啊……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now thaaaaat's what I like to f-feeeeel...!
rows.current: text: 这才是我喜、喜欢的感觉……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...phew!
rows.current: text: ……呼！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I told ya! There's no running away from me, hehehe!
rows.current: text: 早说了！你逃不出我的手掌心，嘿嘿嘿！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: A girl's got a reputation to keep, and not even a nice handsome man like yourself
rows.current: text: 姑娘我还得维护名声，就算你又帅又讨喜，想搞破坏，也别想全身而退！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: is gonna get away with trying to ruin it!

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: In fact, maybe I should teach you a lesson...
rows.current: text: 其实，我也许该给你个教训……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Show you how much endurance a pro like me...
rows.current: text: 让你看看，我这样的专业人士，耐力究竟……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...really has...
rows.current: text: ……到底有多少……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: W-woah big boy!
rows.current: text: 哇、哇，大块头！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was just kidding, you don't have to scramble off!
rows.current: text: 我开玩笑的，你不用慌忙逃走！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Aaaand you definitely didn't have to take the door out on your way, ow!
rows.current: text: 还有，你走的时候真没必要连门都拆了，哎哟！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: You gotta be careful with those, you know. They're often load bearing!
rows.current: text: 那些可得当心点，知道吗？经常都是承重的！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not even us agents will take out a door frame, because you run the risk of-
rows.current: text: 连我们特工都不拆门框，因为一不小心就——

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: -having the ceiling collapse on ya! Darn it!
rows.current: text: ——被塌下来的天花板砸！可恶！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Not even gonna let me enjoy my afterglow before I have to rush around, huh?
rows.current: text: 连事后余韵都不让我享受，就得四处奔忙，是吧？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well I was hoping to dig around for more of my gear, but I guess I'll...
rows.current: text: 本想再翻翻，找些自己的装备，可看来我得……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...wait a sec, what's that falling from up there...?
rows.current: text: ……等下，上头掉下来的是什么……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: No way... I can't believe my luck!
rows.current: text: 不会吧……我的运气也太好了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I was just thinking about how useful a hyper bracer would be right about now!
rows.current: text: 我刚还在想，这会儿要是有个超能护腕可就太有用了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: I'll be able to slide my way out of here in no time, heh!
rows.current: text: 我马上就能一路滑出这地方啦，嘿！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...just let me grab my jacket again...
rows.current: text: ……让我先把外套拿回来……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and away we go!
rows.current: text: ……出发喽！

rows.source: Heh! Heh! Heh!
rows.current: text: 嘿！嘿！嘿！

rows.source: Some of you little folks have some proper fight in you... Heh!
rows.current: text: 你们这些小个子里，有几个还挺能打……嘿！

rows.source: I'd almost thought that the lot of you were merely an annoyance
rows.current: text: 我差点以为你们这群家伙只会惹人烦，没想到还真有个打中了我。呵！

rows.source: but here's one that actually manged to hit me. Heh!
What's next, one of you coming along and knocking me down to-
rows.current: text: 接下来呢，你们还想来一个把我也撞——

rows.source: Give me a break! I just got through smacking you up and down this cavern!
rows.current: text: 饶了我吧！刚才我才揍得你满洞窟乱窜！

rows.source: I'm Cosmobreeder Yiffany, the best of the best!
rows.current: text: 我是宇宙育种者伊吠妮，精英中的精英！

rows.source: For your information, I haven't shown you a fraction of my power!
rows.current: text: 告诉你，我连一丁点真本事都还没使出来！

rows.source: What-!? How can you still move this fast after taking so many tazer blows?!
rows.current: text: 什、什么！？挨了那么多下电击，你怎么还这么快？！

rows.source: Power...? My little yellow furred companion? You wish to speak of power?
rows.current: text: 力量……？黄毛小伙伴，你想谈力量？

rows.source: Perhaps you'd like a lesson in just such a topic as "power"
rows.current: text: 或许，你想上一堂关于“力量”的课

rows.source: and then you can recite it to me, no?
rows.current: text: 再由你背给我听，如何？
text: ……啊……呃啊……

rows.source: G-gonna stand up... again... any... any minute now...
rows.current: text: 我、我马上……就又能……站起来了……

rows.source: ...s-stand up and leave you be... I... mean... owch...
rows.current: text: ……站、站起来就不打扰你了……我……是说……好疼……

rows.source: Here, spunky yellow girl. Take your leave of my domain.
rows.current: text: 好吧，黄毛野丫头，离开我的领地吧。

rows.source: And while you're at it, take this garbage that a fellow small fighter left
rows.current: text: 顺便，把另一个小个子战士留下的垃圾也带走。那次我给他的教训，比给你的还狠。

rows.source: after I had given him an even rougher lesson than yours.
With shoes in hand, Yiffany scrambles out as the Redbull drops deeper into the mines
rows.current: text: 伊吠妮拿着靴子爬出去，红牛则深入矿井，他泛着红光的鬃毛诡异地隐入黑暗……

rows.source: his glowing red mane fading eerily into the dark...

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ugh! What is it with you little pipsqueaks?
rows.current: text: 呃！你们这些小不点到底是怎么回事？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: First you pillage my belongings, then you try to attack me?
rows.current: text: 先是洗劫我的东西，接着又想来攻击我？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Well, you've got another thing coming, you little bra-
rows.current: text: 好啊，你们可想错了，你这个小混-

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: -wait a minute...!
rows.current: text: -等一下……！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Is that really...
rows.current: text: 那真的是……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: text: ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...YES, it is!!
rows.current: text: ……没错，就是它！！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: It's my standard issue Cosmohelm! I've been looking for this since I landed!
rows.current: text: 这就是我的标配Cosmohelm！我一落地就在找它！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: That brat must have squirrelled it away down here!
rows.current: text: 一定是那个小鬼把它偷偷藏到这下面来了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: This is perfect! If I can find my whole suit, I'll be able to go space-walking!
rows.current: text: 太完美了！如果我能找齐整套装备，就能去太空漫步了！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...or at least traverse some low oxygen areas...
rows.current: text: ……或者至少能穿行于一些低氧区域……

rows.source: Aww! What an adorable little guy...!
rows.current: text: 哎呀！多可爱的小家伙……！

rows.source: Why would such a sweet puppy try to rough me up? Huh?
rows.current: text: 这么乖的小狗，为什么要来揍我呢？嗯？

rows.source: You know, there's some really dangerous creatures down in this old depot.
rows.current: text: 你知道吗，这座旧仓库下面可是有些很危险的生物。

rows.source: It's not a good idea for a pup like you to run around trying to play-fight!
rows.current: text: 你这样的小狗，到处找人打闹可不是个好主意！

rows.source: But you don't understand a word I'm sayin' do ya, cutie?

rows.current: lang(Fox): 直到被逼得走投无路，甚至连投降都不可能时，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: did the first of us strike out...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 我们中才终于有人率先反击……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...and retaliate!
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……并奋起反击！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Psychic abilities once turned only towards a common good
rows.current: lang(Fox): 曾经只用于共同福祉的心灵能力，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: would now be turned against those who would try to subjugate us Fenfen!
rows.current: lang(Fox): 如今要用来反抗那些妄图奴役我们Fenfen的敌人！

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: An arsenal of ESPer abilities became harnessed as weapons of war.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 各种超能力就这样被用作战争的武器。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Explosive psychic projectiles blasted away foes.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 爆裂的灵能弹将敌人轰飞。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Punishing waves of telekinetic force prevented advancement of armies.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 强劲的念动力波阻住了大军的推进。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some even went so far as to transform their very bodies into tools for combat.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些人甚至把自己的身体变成了战斗兵器。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Ancient beings heard the cries of mental anguish that rang throughout the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 古老的存在们听见了回荡于整颗星球的精神痛呼，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Some, like the noble Elves, took up ancient weapons in order to aid us Fenfen...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 有些如高贵的精灵，拿起古老兵器援助我们Fenfen……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...while other ancient beings, from deep within the bowels of the planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……而其他古老的存在，则从这颗星球最深的地底，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: awoke with a desire for vengeance and domination of their own...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 带着属于它们自己的复仇与征服欲望苏醒了……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Oh brave hero, thank you for rescuing me and proving your courage.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 勇敢的英雄啊，感谢你救出我，证明了你的勇气。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Now, place your hands upon mine.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 现在，把你的双手放在我的手上。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Turn your mind inward and witness the events that have shaped these lands...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 将心神转向内在，见证塑造这片土地的往事……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Having touched the prison of Traeh, the interloper was no longer themself.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 触碰Traeh的牢笼后，闯入者便不再是原来的自己。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Enough dark psychic power had passed in that one moment of contact
rows.current: lang(Fox): 就在接触的那一刻，已有足够多的黑暗灵能传递了过去，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: that Traeh had a willing minion to send out into the wild.
rows.current: lang(Fox): Traeh也就有了一个甘愿效命的爪牙，可被差往荒野。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: One by one, this twisted agent rounded up the remaining council members
rows.current: lang(Fox): 这名扭曲的特工，把余下的议员逐一抓走，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ensuring that the powers that kept Traeh imprisoned weakened more each day.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 以此确保囚禁Traeh的力量一天天地衰弱下去。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Even if the wise council members were intent on psychically detaining Traeh
rows.current: lang(Fox): 即便睿智的议会成员决意以心灵之力拘禁Traeh，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: after being subjugated to experiment after dark experiment...
rows.current: lang(Fox): 可在遭受一场又一场黑暗实验之后……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...not even the wisest of Fenfen minds could wage battles on that many fronts.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……即便是Fenfen中最智慧的头脑，也无法在如此众多的战线上同时作战。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Without the powers of the Fenfen council to hold Traeh prisoner
rows.current: lang(Fox): 没了Fenfen议会的力量囚禁Traeh

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: it's only a matter of time before she's able to break free and wage war once more.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 她挣脱束缚、再度掀起战争，只是时间问题。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: And this time, there will be no resistance against her evil power.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 而这一次，再没人能抵挡她的邪恶力量。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: The only thing that keeps this evil Queen from conquering all of Tutone
rows.current: lang(Fox): 唯一让这邪恶女王尚未征服整个图托恩的，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: is her desire to gain enough strength to transfer into a new host body.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 只是她想先积攒足够的力量，转移到新的宿主身体里。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Perhaps, then, it is another twist of Fate that sent you to this planet
rows.current: lang(Fox): 那么，或许又是命运的转折，将你送来这颗星球，

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: and had you arrive so near to where all this calamitous action took place.
rows.current: lang(Fox): 并且让你来到距离这场灾难发生之地如此之近的地方。

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Will you be an even more powerful host for Traeh, Queen of Darkness?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 你会成为黑暗女王Traeh更强大的宿主吗？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: Or will you be the saviour of the Fenfen, a beacon of courage and hope...?
rows.current: lang(Fox): 还是说，你会成为Fenfen的救星，勇气与希望的明灯……？

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……

rows.speaker: narrator
rows.source: ...Only you can decide, hero.
rows.current: lang(Fox): ……只有你能决定，英雄。

rows.speaker: HardFox
rows.source: Thou hast fought a fair round for such an untrained hand.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 汝虽未经锤炼，这一战却也打得不差。

rows.speaker: HardFox
rows.source: Pray, tell me thine name so that I may honor thee.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 敢问阁下尊姓大名，好让吾致以敬意。

rows.speaker: HardFox
rows.source: ...ahh, but the people of thy land do not speaketh my tongue...
rows.current: lang(HardFox): ……啊，然而汝故土之民，并不通晓吾之言语……

rows.source: W-what? No matter how much I fight... There's just no winning!
rows.current: text: 什、什么？再怎么打……都赢不了！

rows.source: Who are you? W-what are you doing down here?
rows.current: text: 你是谁？你、你在下面做什么？

rows.speaker: HardFox
rows.source: I need not speaketh your crude tongue in order to understand your crude desire
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 无需说汝那粗鄙之语，吾亦明了汝粗鄙之欲

rows.speaker: HardFox
rows.source: So struggle not as I placeth a most useful trinket upon thee.
rows.current: lang(HardFox): 莫要挣扎，且让吾为汝戴上这实用的小饰物。

rows.source: H-hey! What the hell is this? I'm not some darn pet of yours to collar!
rows.current: text: 喂、喂！搞什么鬼？我又不是你家宠物，戴什么项圈！

rows.source: I'll find a way to bring you down, just give me a minute and I'll-
rows.current: text: 我会想办法打倒你的，给我一分钟，我就——

rows.source: And thou shall do what, fairest knight?
rows.current: text: 那么，俊美的骑士，汝又待如何？

rows.source: Mine powers are ancient and forgotten, and thou are but a pup lost in the dark.
rows.current: text: 吾之力量古老而被世人遗忘，汝不过是迷失黑暗的小犬。

rows.source: Prayeth that I overlook your ill mannered outburst, as the generous host I am.
rows.current: text: 祈求吾这位宽宏的主人，不计较汝方才的无礼罢。

rows.source: Now taketh this necklace so that you may understand others of this land
rows.current: text: 且收下这项链，好让汝听懂此地众人的话语……也省得旁人再领教汝的无礼……呵呵呵呵……

rows.source: ...and spareth them from your ill manners...eh heh heh heh...
And with a gutteral laugh, the demonic form faded back into the darkest darks
rows.current: text: 伴着喉间一阵低笑，那魔影退回了最深的黑暗，只留下一个吓坏了的小狗崽……

rows.source: leaving nought but a scared pup in his wake...
Awww, look at you! You're adorable! And small!
rows.current: text: 哎呀，瞧瞧你！真可爱！还这么小！

rows.source: What made you decide to start roughhousing with me, lil guy?
rows.current: text: 小家伙，你怎么会想来跟我打闹呢？

rows.source: You're lucky that it was only me that you started tussling with
rows.current: text: 算你走运，你惹上的只是我，

rows.source: and not any of the more vicious creatures down here!
rows.current: text: 而不是这下面那些更凶狠的生物！

rows.source: Some of them are pretty nasty, you know?
rows.current: text: 有些家伙可相当凶，你知道吗？

rows.source: Awww but you don't know what I'm going on about, do you?
rows.current: text: 哎呀，不过你听不懂我在说什么，对吧？

rows.source: A cute little guy like you just wants to run and jump around...
rows.current: text: 你这么可爱的小家伙，只想四处跑跑跳跳……

rows.source: ...and that's what you should be allowed to do!
rows.current: text: ……就该让你自由自在地这么做才对！

rows.source: Go on lil guy! Have more fun out there!
rows.current: text: 去吧，小家伙！到外面多玩玩！

rows.source: Your big ol' uncle Yiffai will be around if you get into trouble
rows.current: text: 要是碰上麻烦，你的伊吠大叔就在附近，

rows.source: so don't hesitate to bark out for help! I'll come a'runnin.
rows.current: text: 尽管汪汪叫着求救！我会跑过来的。

rows.source: O-oh hey! That's some pretty mighty digging you're doing...
rows.current: text: 哦、哦嘿！你挖得可真起劲……

rows.source: Did you forget a bone or maybe a ball or something...
rows.current: text: 你是不是忘了骨头，或者球之类的什么东西……

rows.source: Or... or...
rows.current: text: 还是……还是……

rows.source: ...or is that a Level 1 Keycard? And you're giving it to me!?
rows.current: text: ……还是说，那是张1级门卡？而你要把它送给我！？

rows.source: Well heck! Ain't you just the best little nephew Uncle Yiffai could want?
rows.current: text: 哎呀！伊吠大叔哪还能找到比你更棒的小侄子？

rows.source: Thanks pupperoo, I won't forget it!
rows.current: text: 谢谢你，小狗崽，我不会忘记的！
